workerResult.summary: BRINE CLOCK 潮汐時計 — a living japanese-cyberpunk tide timer. A glowing canvas tide dial: a pink hand sweeps one rotation per M2 lunar tide cycle (~12h25m) while an animated neon water disc rises/falls with a synthetic M2+S2+K1 harmonic tide model (normalized 0-100%), and a 24h tide sparkline wraps the ring with amber/cyan markers at the next high 満潮 and low 干潮. Live readouts: level %, rising/falling trend (満ち/引き), phase, and countdowns to next high/low. TIME WARP core interaction: scrub −12h..+48h, play at 60×/3600×, or snap LIVE (speed persisted in localStorage). Share/export: copy formatted tide snapshot to clipboard (with fallback), download a neon 24h tide chart PNG (offscreen canvas, high/low + NOW markers), and download a 24h forecast JSON (30-min points + upcoming events). Easter egg: click the 潮汐 tide seal 5× (flickers at 3) or type 'kraken' to awaken 海神 KRAKEN — glowing tentacles + an eye rise in the dial, page shivers, auto-calms in 12s or dismiss with one click. Japanese-cyberpunk identity: ink/neon palette (cyan #00eaff, pink #ff2e88, wasabi #c6ff3e), Zen Tokyo Zoo + Noto Sans JP + Share Tech Mono, cut-corner clip-path panels, scanline + CRT vignette overlays, drifting aura blobs, kanji labels. Zero images — dial, water, waves, markers, and tentacles are all canvas; everything else is pure CSS. Verified in-browser at 1280px and 375px: no horizontal overflow, zero console errors, Lighthouse accessibility 100; warp, live-reset, copy/PNG/JSON export, and both easter-egg triggers all tested working.
